design_archetype.name: Organic & Earthy
design_archetype.rationale: Patients/Users need warmth, calm, trust for spiritual and mental reflection. A grounded, natural, and minimalist design removes distractions and encourages vulnerability.

deck_21_30.label: 21-30 Anos
deck_21_30.description: Saúde mental, conversas difíceis, maturidade espiritual

home_screen.layout: Flex column, centered content, mobile-first constraint (max-w-md mx-auto).
home_screen.header: Title 'Dinâmicas' in h1, subtitle 'Escolhe o baralho para começar' in body text.
home_screen.deck_list: 3 stacked large cards (Bento-style list). Each card uses its respective deck color as a subtle background or left-border accent. High padding (p-8).

card_screen.layout: Flex column, full height (h-screen). Top navigation bar with Back button and Progress pill.

top_nav.progress_pill: Center aligned. E.g., '5 / 23'. Uses text_secondary and bg_soft of the active deck.

active_card.style: Massive central card taking up 70vh. Pure white bg, soft shadow, 1px border. Flex center for text.
active_card.interaction: Tap anywhere on the card. First tap reveals the question. Next tap advances to the next random question.
active_card.typography: Question text must be large (text-2xl or text-3xl), centered, high contrast (#2D3A34).

exhausted_screen.layout: Flex column, centered, inside the main card area or a full screen replacement.
exhausted_screen.content: Message 'Baralho Concluído!' and 'Todas as cartas foram lidas. O baralho foi reiniciado.'
exhausted_screen.action: Button 'Voltar ao Início' to go to home screen.

motion_and_interactions.card_transition: Use Framer Motion. When tapping to reveal, use a subtle scale-up or 3D flip. When advancing to the next card, slide the current card out to the left and slide the new one in from the right.
motion_and_interactions.list_stagger: On the home screen, the 3 deck buttons should animate in with a slight stagger (0.1s delay each).

assets_and_media.images: No external images required. Use pure CSS gradients, soft colored backgrounds, and minimalist typography to keep the app lightweight and distraction-free.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a React (or Next.js) web application styled specifically for mobile viewports (max-w-md mx-auto, min-h-screen).
Use Tailwind CSS for all styling, strictly adhering to the colors and typography defined.
Include the fonts Outfit and DM Sans via Google Fonts.
Implement the card deck logic: Randomize array of questions on load, keep track of current index, prevent repeats until the array is fully traversed.
Ensure all data-testids are implemented exactly as specified.
Make the card tap target massive (the entire card surface) so passing the device and tapping is frictionless.

deck_21_30: Como tens lidado com a tua saúde mental ultimamente?
